declarations.docstring: A simple representation embedded equivariantly in the polynomial quotient embeds equivariantly in some member of the auxiliary representation family.
Every homogeneous component of an element of the auxiliary polynomial submodule remains in that submodule.
Taking a homogeneous component commutes with the displayed general linear group action on multivariate polynomials.
The underlying submodules of the auxiliary subrepresentation family are independent.
The underlying submodules of the auxiliary subrepresentation family span the entire quotient representation.
An auxiliary natural-number-indexed linear endomorphism of the displayed polynomial quotient.
The auxiliary linear endomorphism commutes with the displayed general linear group action on the quotient.
The auxiliary linear endomorphism fixes each element of the correspondingly indexed auxiliary subrepresentation.
The image of the auxiliary linear endomorphism belongs to the correspondingly indexed auxiliary subrepresentation.
On a quotient class, the auxiliary linear endomorphism is represented by the correspondingly indexed homogeneous component.
The auxiliary linear endomorphism at one index vanishes on an auxiliary subrepresentation at a distinct index.
